title: Universal Listing Card Rendering & Badge Truth Table
description: Exhaustive boolean truth table determining primary badges, visual callouts, and secondary action buttons on listing cards across all 8 modular LEGO block types.

propositions.name: Has Commercial Price
propositions.description: Item has a commercial price string (e.g. '$14.99') rather than being a free protocol.

propositions.name: Has Temporal Curfew
propositions.description: Item has strict rail/bus departure curfew hours (e.g. 23:23).

propositions.name: Has Formal Truth Table
propositions.description: Item contains executable boolean truth conditions for scam or threat detection.

propositions.name: Critical or SPOF Mitigator
propositions.description: Item mitigates an active single point of failure or carries Critical risk tier.

outputVariables.description: Badge tone: green, amber, red, purple, blue.
SPEC_CARD vs CURFEW_CARD vs TRUTH_DOSSIER_CARD vs PROTOCOL_CARD.

rows.formalRationale: Critical life-safety items and active SPOFs always render in high-visibility red with immediate actionable intervention.

outputs.quickActionType: View Train Curfew & Official Taxi Booth

rows.formalRationale: Airport and transit items with temporal curfews feature amber alerts highlighting express train countdowns.
Threat scams with truth tables highlight verifiable binary checks for fast field assessment.
Physical hardware and digital SaaS tools display price tier, rating, and comparison drawer triggers.
Open protocols without commercial pricing or curfews render clean educational cards.

title: Gemini Grounded Search Data Ingestion Quality Gate
description: Formal boolean truth table verifying whether data harvested via Google Gemini Grounded Search qualifies for automated pSEO listing generation.

propositions.name: Schema Validation Passed
propositions.description: Raw JSON output strictly satisfies Draft-2020-12 target schema.

propositions.name: Official Citation Domain
propositions.description: Google Search Grounding cited official airport, municipal, or consular website.

propositions.name: Low Hallucination Score
propositions.description: Grounding overlap ratio is under 0.15 (strong grounding token match).

propositions.name: Duplicate of Existing Entity
propositions.description: Matches an existing SKU, IATA code, or slug already stored in PostgreSQL.

outputs.storageAction: Log failure to data_harvest_audit_logs; do not insert into production.

rows.formalRationale: Schema non-compliance is an immediate hard reject to preserve frontend type safety.

outputs.storageAction: Insert into PostgreSQL and queue Next.js on-demand ISR revalidation.

rows.formalRationale: Golden Harvest: Valid schema, official citation, low hallucination, unique new entity.

outputs.storageAction: Run diff engine; update fields if curfew or flat-rate changed, log audit diff.

rows.formalRationale: Self-healing knowledge graph: updates existing entity with fresh data without creating duplicate URLs.

outputs.storageAction: Save to staging_harvest_queue with citation warning for human sign-off.

rows.formalRationale: Non-official citations (e.g. blog, forum) must be human-verified before entering pSEO index.

outputs.storageAction: Flag hallucination risk; require manual source verification.

rows.formalRationale: High hallucination score indicates model generated claims unsupported by cited text.
